text: U.S. stock markets are trading with caution today as investors weigh geopolitical tensions in the Middle East against the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision and upcoming major technology earnings. While the Dow Jones Industrial Average has shown strength, driven by gains in the energy and industrial sectors amid a sharp rise in crude oil prices, the technology sector remains muted due to ongoing concerns regarding artificial intelligence capital expenditures. Market volatility remains elevated as participants await further clarity on monetary policy and corporate performance.
